quotes.text: I was a songwriter. I wasn't really much of an entertainer.
People always come up to you and say, 'Man, I thought you were dead.' It's really weird.
I've always enjoyed playing. If all it meant were to just stand there and play my axe and sing, I could have gone on forever.
I feel like I have more control over the way I want to pursue making music.
I've always tried to come up with something that would catch your ear.
I'd say writing songs is, for me, as much playing the tape recorder as it is playing guitar or writing words.
Before, if you didn't get up and dance, if you sat and watched me play, I got real nervous. Now, I kind of know what it is I do, and it's easier to get up there.
I figure that most people will remember me for the songs I wrote. I can still do that pretty well _ at least as well as Mick Jagger can still stomp around on stage.
